crossRefs.note: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”
Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, “Yahweh will deliver us.” Have any of the gods of the nations delivered…
Bel bows down. Nebo stoops. Their idols are carried by animals, and on the livestock. The things that you carried…
They stoop and they bow down together. They could not deliver the burden, but they have gone into captivity.
He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and…
They left their images there; and David and his men took them away.
A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.
So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith. He who smoothes with the hammer encourages him who strikes the anvil, saying…
Everyone who makes a carved image is vain. The things that they delight in will not profit. Their own witnesses don’t…
Who has fashioned a god, or molds an image that is profitable for nothing?
The rest of it he makes into a god, even his engraved image. He bows down to it and worships, and prays to it, and…
Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cuts a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman…
“You shall say this to them: ‘The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth, and…
For this is even from Israel! The workman made it, and it is no God; indeed, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in…

parallels.note: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone. Therefore…

translations.web: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.
translations.bsb: They have cast their gods into the fire and destroyed them, for they were not gods, but only wood and stone—the work of human hands.
